Make one full-size layer filled with your accent gradient and animate clip-path with inset() values that interpolate smoothly: pill inset(40% 22% 40% 22% round 40px), rounded square inset(17% 26.5% 17% 26.5% round 40px) (compute the side insets from the box aspect ratio so it is truly square), card inset(12% 12% 12% 12% round 20px). Use a slight-overshoot easing such as cubic-bezier(.34,1.35,.5,1) for the expand steps and ease for the return, and cycle on a 7-8 second loop with long holds. Put three content layers inside (a "Play" label, an icon, and a title with two skeleton lines) and cross-fade them with opacity and a small translateY as each shape lands. Trigger by click or hover in a real product (play button morphs to a mini player), and respect prefers-reduced-motion by switching shapes without interpolation. Keep it keyboard reachable with a visible :focus-visible state, and under prefers-reduced-motion drop the motion and keep the final static state. Plain HTML, CSS and JS, no libraries.
